description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Buff Earth 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Vengeful Earth Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Buff Earth 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Vengeful Earth Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Vengeful Earth after using two Earth abilities

description.name: Vengeful Earth
description.text: One single attack (1.80), causes [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)] and [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], 100% hit rate
